items.topic: Reviewer decisions must be recorded by a tool call in the same turn
items.claim: Skill only said 'record decisions with review-decide.mjs' and never when; reviewer sessions stated decisions in chat without recording them.
items.fact: A decision exists only once `node .pi/skills/blueprint-review/review-decide.mjs set <id> <decision> "note"` has run. When a reviewer says accept/reject/defer/needs change in chat, the session must run `set` in that same turn, base its reply on the tool output, say 'recorded' only after a `saved for <you>: …` line, report failures, clarify unclear wording first, and re-run `set` when a decision changes. Added to SKILL.md ('Decisions are tool calls, never text') and one line in initial-prompt.md.

items.topic: Review-docker skill copies must be synced to each reviewer workspace; running sessions need reload
items.claim: Skill edits in target/review-docker/skill/blueprint-review apply to reviewers automatically.
items.fact: Source of truth is target/review-docker/skill/blueprint-review/; copies live in target/review-docker/work/<user>/.pi/skills/blueprint-review/ (boti, gabor, robi, mate) and must be re-copied (cmp to check). Reviewer sessions use the workspace copies, not repo-root .pi/skills (which lacked blueprint-review). Already running sessions keep old instructions until restart/new spawn or /reload. Verify with `review-decide.mjs whoami` and `list --undecided` from the workspace.

items.topic: Broadcast /reload to live pi sessions via dashboard MCP
items.fact: Operator asked to 'emit /reload to all sessions'. Use mcp__pi_dashboard__list_sessions (filter status active/idle/streaming; full list output is huge and truncated, parse the saved temp file with python) and mcp__pi_dashboard__send_prompt {sessionId,text:'/reload'} per session. Skip the current session (reload mid-turn would cut off the reply). Streaming sessions run /reload after their current turn. ctx_execute_file cannot read files outside the project root (/var/folders temp); use python3 via bash.

items.topic: Review app jumps to top / flickers / loses typing every 15 s
items.claim: refreshMerged() every 15s calls show(current) which rebuilds the whole topic pane and sets #main scrollTop=0; the 'typing' guard checks only document.activeElement at that instant.
items.fact: Expected: periodic sync must not disturb scroll, focus or typing. Fixes: skip if merged data signature (lastMergedSig = JSON.stringify(M)) unchanged; skip rebuild while TEXTAREA/INPUT/SELECT focused or a save is pending (the `timers` debounce map must delete its entry when the timeout fires, otherwise 'pending' stays true forever); show(id, focusId, keepScroll) preserves scrollTop. Pitfall: a `let lastMergedSig` declared after code that uses it blanked the whole page (TDZ); declare with the other globals (`let D, S, M, current`).
items.evidence: session 2026-11-06T14:21-14:30, agent; index.html refreshMerged ~l.736, show ~l.534, saveItem timers l.367

items.topic: Operator: don't rebuild the whole view, only the changed component
items.claim: Agent's first fix still re-rendered the whole topic when data changed.
items.fact: Operator: "DON'T REBUILD THE WHOLE THING only data change only rebuild that component not its parents". Implemented: each card's team-vote block is a slot `data-team-slot=<id>`, topic header chips/conflict summary a `data-status-slot=<topic id>` (statusHtml(t)); refreshMerged rewrites only slots whose content changed, never touching notes/scroll/typing; sidebar refreshed only if affected and not in use. Principle: fine-grained updates of changed components, not parent re-render.

items.topic: Verifying the review app in agent-browser requires Keycloak sign-in
items.fact: Review app (http://192.168.10.219:8791, server target/review-app/server.py, log /tmp/review-app.log) uses the same Keycloak realm pi-identity as the dashboard; without sessionStorage 'rtok' /api/data returns 401 and the page stays 'Loading…'. Silent sign-in returns ?error=login_required and shows Keycloak form, so the agent cannot run live scroll tests without credentials. #main is not necessarily the scroller (scroll tests read 0); `agent-browser find role button "…" click` syntax with quotes fails; first parallel `open` can fail with 'daemon started concurrently' — retry. Also raw curl is blocked by the context-mode hook; use `curl -s -o /tmp/x URL`.

items.topic: Review app: Why/Evidence/Catalog searches shown as bordered sub-cards inside modification card
items.claim: Why and Evidence rendered as plain text blocks in the card.
items.fact: Operator: "Issue! put the why and evidence into cards!" Implemented a `.subcard` class (bordered, rounded, page colours) wrapping Why, Evidence and 'Catalog searches by the miner' sections in modCard().

items.topic: Review app: quick-add form hidden behind '+ Add missing' button
items.claim: The quick-add missing-topic form (#quick-add: qa-title, qa-text, qa-target) was always fully visible in the sidebar.
items.fact: Operator: "This should not show up fully! add a + add missing button only that opens a form!" Form is hidden by default, toggled by a `#qa-open` button (aria-expanded/aria-controls), with Cancel and closing after adding; submit handler at index.html ~l.629 calls addTopic(title,text,target).

items.topic: kb guard nags after 3 source searches without kb_search
items.fact: The pi kb guard prints '[kb] 3 consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base' and blocks/warns on repeated grep/sed; run kb_search / kb agents <path> / kb get first (or kb_guard_pause) when doing bulk source exploration. Also: a python edit script with multiple rep() asserts writes nothing if one assert fails — remove the stale step and rerun.
